sloka: उभे सम्ध्ये शयानस्य यत् पापम् परिकल्प्यते ।तच् च पापम् भवेत् तस्य यस्य आर्यो अनुमते गतः ॥२-७५-४४॥
transliteration: ubhe samdhye śayānasya yat pāpam parikalpyate ।tac ca pāpam bhavet tasya yasya āryo anumate gataḥ ॥2-75-44॥

translations.english: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother acquire the extent of demerit fixed for a person, who sleeps at the hour of twilight of dawn and dusk
